config.shard_kernel: per shard: sequential fused chain over its contiguous hidden slice, start +0
config.tree: level k: node i absorbs node i + 2^k for every multiple i of 2^(k+1); root = node 0 on rank 0, then binomial broadcast
config.ownership: contiguous blocks of shards, rank r owns chunk r of S into P

rejected_policies.name: bf16-wire/fp32-add
rejected_policies.reason: its reduce wire cannot carry every accumulator value exactly, so a node would round a child only because it crossed ranks

config.ideal: exact sum of the S FP32 shard partials rounded once to the output format

link_model.note: illustrative alpha-beta model; not a measurement
